🚀 Cybertruck 2 Year Review: Is It Still Worth It in 2026?
 📷Two years after taking delivery, here’s my honest, no-filter look at living with the Tesla Cybertruck every single day. 

From real-world range and charging habits to durability after thousands of miles, daily driving quirks, software updates, and how the FSD experience has evolved — I’m covering it all.

In this video I share what surprised me the most, what still needs improvement, and whether the Cybertruck remains the ultimate futuristic truck or if the hype has cooled off after two full years of ownership.

If you’re thinking about buying a Cybertruck in 2026, or you already own one and want to hear real long-term thoughts, this review is for you.
